pages.title: Rate Lock Desk
pages.content: Rate lock extensions require a request to the lock desk before the current expiration date. Include the loan number and requested extension period.

pages.title: Appraisal Ordering
pages.content: Order an appraisal after the initial disclosures are acknowledged. Send appraisal questions to the valuation team.

pages.title: Underwriting Conditions
pages.content: Upload underwriting condition documents to the loan file and notify the assigned underwriter when the package is complete.

pages.title: Closing Disclosure
pages.content: The closing disclosure must be delivered before the closing appointment. Coordinate corrections with the closing team.

pages.title: Wire Verification
pages.content: Verify wire instructions by calling the recipient using a trusted phone number before sending funds.

pages.title: Payoff Requests
pages.content: Request a payoff statement from the current servicer and check the good-through date before closing.

pages.title: Employment Verification
pages.content: Complete verbal employment verification shortly before funding and record the conversation in the loan file.

pages.title: Flood Insurance
pages.content: Review the flood determination and obtain flood insurance when the property is in a required flood zone.

pages.title: Escrow Accounts
pages.content: An escrow account collects property taxes and insurance with the monthly mortgage payment.

pages.title: Post Closing Shipping
pages.content: After funding, the post closing team reviews the signed package and ships the required documents to the investor.

pages.title: Manager Draft Compensation
pages.content: The proposed manager compensation schedule is a confidential draft for management review only.
